title: A Closed-Loop Study of Runtime Governance for AI-Driven IoT: reproducibility package
description: Software-in-the-loop testbed and deployable governance service for the Sensors paper 'A Closed-Loop Study of Runtime Governance for AI-Driven IoT'. Closes the control loop through a physical plant model and measures which runtime governance mechanism reduces physical risk; the principal result is that admission control removes a substantial fraction of the unsafe exposure while checkpoint rollback removes only a further 0.2%. No physical hardware was operated.
